messages:
sophie: quick heads-up — HelixHealth SI go-live blocked, partner's marketplace image fails on their P3 hardware.
rahul: @sophie can you share the marketplace tag and a short error?
james: also what host drivers are they running? sounds like a kernel/module mismatch usually.
naomi: on call with the customer — they see crashloop with nvml errors, probe shows device not found.
sophie: image tag: `redwood/si-marketplace:v1.3.4-prod`. logs:
```
Failed to load kernel module nvidia-uvm: -2
inference-service: error opening /dev/nvidia0: No such file or directory
```
rahul: that looks like host NVIDIA driver <-> container CUDA runtime mismatch. Which Dell image firmware/driver version?
naomi: partner reports host driver 525.60.13 (can't upgrade pre-maintenance window).
james: our marketplace images were built against 525.78.09 kernels. Options: rebuild image against 525.60.x, provide shim module, or route traffic off their cluster until they can upgrade.
sophie: partner says maintenance window Thu 02:00 UTC; customer needs Mon go-live. We need a short-term mitigation.
rahul: propose temporary routing to Dedicated capacity (us-west-2) while we patch marketplace image. That keeps customer live and avoids forcing host upgrades.
james: technically doable — add a routing policy that pins their org ID to dedicated pool. Will need ACL + billing tag. ETA ~1h to create policy + route.
naomi: customer ok with short-term routing if latency stays within SLA. They want telemetry and cost visibility annotated.
sophie: creating a quick runbook for partner handoff and rollback. putting notes in the shared doc.
rahul: can you add a canary: 10% then 100% after smoke tests? I want trace-level logs to confirm no quality regressions.
naomi: doing smoke now — basic prompts succeed on fallback. I'll keep the customer on the call until we flip.
deploybot: policy created: `partner-routing/helix-temp-fallback` -> dedicated-us-west-2, canary=10%, author=deploybot
james: promoted to 100% after 3 green checks. latency delta +18ms, error rate 0.0% in canary window. cost delta ~+12% token unit.
sophie: partner informed, customer confirmed functional. Marking this as mitigated short-term.
rahul: next steps: (1) sophie to coordinate marketplace image rebuild targeting 525.60.x and CI test matrix, (2) james to prepare automated image builds for multiple host-driver tags, (3) naomi to send official customer comms and confirm maintenance schedule.
naomi: customer wants a timeline for permanent fix — target PR and patch by Wed EOD.
sophie: noted. I'll open a small RFC and link it in the doc: https://redwood.atlassian/si/2270004321-patch-plan
james: I'll queue a parallel build in our image pipeline and add driver tag matrix, ETA 48h.
rahul: thanks team. I'll update the partner SOW and record the routing override and cost center mapping. Reopen thread if anything breaks. :thumbsup:
sophie: filing a short postmortem after go-live to capture onboarding gaps and marketplace image testing gaps.
naomi: customer happy to proceed with maintenance window. closing on our side once patch verified. :white_check_mark:
sophie: great work — thanks everyone.
